components.label: Powered sub cabinet
components.purpose: Front-loaded 18-inch powered subwoofer, about 533 wide × 635 high × 597 deep mm and 52 kg (retailers list 115–121 lb). Built on a 15-inch-sub footprint with a full-width steel grille.
components.limits: Envelope and weight are retailer figures; no manufacturer sheet is published any more.

components.label: SW18C 18-inch driver
components.purpose: 18-inch SW18C woofer with a 3-inch voice coil, 700 W continuous and 1400 W peak from the built-in amplifier, 39–135 Hz ±3 dB, 131 dB max SPL.
components.limits: Driver model and ratings are retailer copies of the spec table.

components.label: Power input (fused) and power switch
components.purpose: Quick-reference items 1–2: IEC inlet with fuse and the on/off switch. Turn the level down before powering on.

components.label: Audio input L and R · XLR or 1/4 in TRS
components.purpose: Item 3: balanced XLR and TRS inputs for line or mic level signals. The input is buffered and passed to Thru.

components.label: Audio Thru · XLR or 1/4 in
components.purpose: Item 4: buffered copy of the input that bypasses the sub controls, for a full-range top cabinet. The High Pass switch affects this signal; leave it on Bypass if unsure.

components.label: Link Out with Master/Slave switch
components.purpose: Item 5: output for daisy-chaining more CVA subs. Set the low pass on the first sub as Master; the rest take it over Link as Slave.

components.label: Power, Limit, Protect and Signal LEDs
components.purpose: Item 6: Power stays lit; Limit blinks when the limiter works; Protect means the amplifier shut itself down; Signal shows input present.

components.label: Level
components.purpose: Item 7: master input level to the amplifier. Keep it down while powering on or switching Mic/Line.

components.label: High Pass (to Thru) · 65 / 85 / 130 Hz / bypass
components.purpose: Item 8: four-position switch that removes low frequencies from the Thru feed to the tops so they do not fight the sub.

components.label: Variable Low Pass · 65–130 Hz
components.purpose: Continuously variable low-pass setting the top of the sub's band; passed to slaved subs over Link.
components.limits: Range is from retailer copies; the quick reference names the control.

components.label: Side handles and pole cup
components.purpose: Recessed side handles for a two-person lift and a pole cup on top for a satellite top.
components.limits: Not described in the quick reference.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated CVA-118 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Two subs, one setting
Feed the first sub, set its Low Pass and make it Master. Link Out to the second sub set to Slave so both roll off at the same point. Tops come off Thru with the High Pass set to match.
The quick reference says leave High Pass on Bypass if unsure.
